speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify your symptoms: do you feel you are actually hearing voices from animals, or do you only *believe* they are communicating telepathically? Additionally, have you experienced any recent head injuries or started any new medications?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' He has started taking assorted Peruvian herbs without any improvement. He denies taking any medications. The symptoms have been ongoing for the past eight months.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is an unusual restriction; can you describe specifically how the weather affects this loss of ability, and do you have any hallucinations or delusions about animals in your environment? REQUEST TEST: Urine_Toxicity_Screen to rule out heavy metal poisoning or toxins from the herbs you took.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Patient is not on any medication and has no significant past medical history. Social history: Lives alone, works at a health food store. Dresses in all burlap clothing and attempts telepathic communication during history taking.
